mapper.select: SELECT t.tag_id, t.name, t.user_id, t.create_time, COUNT(r.note_id) as noteCount FROM note_tag t LEFT JOIN note_tag_rel r ON t.tag_id = r.tag_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY t.tag_id ORDER BY t.create_time DESC

SELECT n.note_id AS id, n.title AS title, LEFT(n.content, 120) AS summary, u.nickname AS author, u.avatar AS avatar, CASE WHEN n.is_public = 1 THEN '公开' ELSE '私密' END AS type, CASE WHEN IFNULL(cur.attitude, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isLiked, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM note_reaction nr WHERE nr.note_id = n.note_id AND nr.attitude = 1 ) AS likes, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM note_comment nc WHERE nc.note_id = n.note_id AND nc.del_flag = 0 ) AS comments FROM note n INNER JOIN note_tag_rel tr ON tr.note_id = n.note_id INNER JOIN note_tag t ON t.tag_id = tr.tag_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = n.user_id LEFT JOIN note_reaction cur ON cur.note_id = n.note_id AND cur.user_id = #{userId} WHERE tr.tag_id = #{tagId} AND t.user_id = #{userId} AND n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.del_flag = 0 AND n.status = 1 ORDER BY n.update_time DESC
